output.reason: [ev-274ce3859ab9] says the `istiod-remote` chart was removed in favor of installing istio-discovery with `--set profile=remote`. [ev-5a31c0781dc5] and the upgrade guide [ev-1295567312b0] say the chart was merged into istio-discovery and give the new install command `helm install istiod istio/istiod --set profile=remote`. Both also say the istio-base chart is now required in local and remote clusters. Because the chart no longer exists, operators who used it must switch to the replacement, so migration-required is supported, and medium severity fits a change that upstream calls never officially documented or stable.
